dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave curvature along the posterior edge from the apex to the point of insertion on the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a medium pixel radius; lacks acute tapering.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 35-degree angular ascent relative to the horizontal dorsal body line.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad, smooth convexity with a large radius extending from the blowhole to the rostral junction.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short length and high thickness observed in the projection extending from the melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle measured at the pixel junction where the melon slope meets the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single light-colored, elliptical depigmented mark located on the dorsal flank posterior to the fin base.
other_distinctive_markers: Clear visualization of the blowhole on the dorsal cranial surface and the presence of a ventrally extending pectoral fin.
